name: Processes
description: The processes of this Mac: the busiest ones by CPU and by memory as status tables, the focused app's resource summary, every process as an `@processes` row in the flashlight, and `process kill --pid=<pid>`, which asks before it terminates one.

top_count.description: Rows of #{flash.plugin.processes.top_cpu} and #{flash.plugin.processes.top_mem}: aligned tables of the busiest processes by CPU and by resident memory (conky's ${top}), sampled every 2 seconds only while the bar, a popup or a widget shows one of them.

commands.description: Terminate the process --pid=<pid> names, after asking
